answer.text: Qualified Institutional Buyers such as financial institutions, mutual funds and banks

explanation.text: The Logic: QIBs are Qualified Institutional Buyers. The workbook expands them to include financial institutions, mutual funds and banks, among others, as investors eligible to participate in QIPs. The Trap: The other expansions are not standard terms. QIP investors are QIBs; do not invent QIP-only IPO buckets that are not supported by the source page. Note: Keep the QIB definition tied to the source wording rather than to a specific IPO allocation bucket or to additional investor categories that the checked pages do not list.
